vocabulary.definition: The relationship between friends; state of mutual trust and care.
vocabulary.example: True friendship is based on honesty, trust, and mutual respect.

vocabulary.definition: Acknowledge a notable day or event with a social gathering.
vocabulary.example: We gathered with close friends to celebrate her graduation.

vocabulary.definition: A joyful social gathering or act marking a special event.
vocabulary.example: The wedding celebration was filled with lively music and dancing.

vocabulary.definition: The anniversary of the day on which a person was born.
vocabulary.example: We surprised him with a homemade chocolate birthday cake.

vocabulary.definition: A thing given to someone as a gift.
vocabulary.example: She wrapped the birthday present in colorful blue paper.

vocabulary.definition: A thing given willingly to someone without payment; present.
vocabulary.example: A photo album filled with shared memories is a thoughtful gift.

vocabulary.definition: A social gathering of invited guests for conversation and food.
vocabulary.example: They hosted a surprise party for their friend's graduation.

vocabulary.definition: A person who is invited to visit someone's home or attend an event.
vocabulary.example: The host warmly greeted every guest at the front door.

vocabulary.definition: A person who receives or entertains other people as guests.
vocabulary.example: She was a gracious host who ensured everyone felt comfortable.

vocabulary.definition: A written or spoken request inviting someone to attend an event.
vocabulary.example: We received a lovely printed invitation to their wedding.

vocabulary.definition: Make a formal or informal request to someone to join an event.
vocabulary.example: I want to invite our neighbors over for Sunday afternoon tea.

vocabulary.definition: An official day of celebration or recreation when work is suspended.
vocabulary.example: New Year's Day is a public holiday celebrated worldwide.

vocabulary.definition: A special day or period of celebration with music, food, and arts.
vocabulary.example: The lantern festival lit up the night sky with glowing colors.

vocabulary.definition: The transmission of customs or beliefs from generation to generation.
vocabulary.example: Eating pumpkin pie on Thanksgiving is a beloved American tradition.

vocabulary.definition: A traditional and widely accepted way of behaving in a society.
vocabulary.example: It is a customary tradition to bring flowers when visiting someone's home.

vocabulary.definition: Something remembered from the past; a recollection.
vocabulary.example: Looking at old photo albums brought back fond childhood memories.

vocabulary.definition: Have in or be able to bring to one's mind an awareness of someone.
vocabulary.example: I will always remember the kindness you showed me.

vocabulary.definition: Fail to remember; be unable to recall from memory.
vocabulary.example: Never forget to tell your family how much you appreciate them.

vocabulary.definition: Firm belief in the reliability, truth, ability, or strength of someone.
vocabulary.example: A healthy friendship is built on mutual trust and honesty.

vocabulary.definition: Giving or showing firm and constant support or allegiance to a friend.
vocabulary.example: A loyal friend stands by your side during difficult times.

vocabulary.definition: Free of deceit and untruthfulness; sincere and truthful.
vocabulary.example: Thank you for giving me your honest opinion on my essay.

vocabulary.definition: Having or showing a friendly, generous, and considerate nature.
vocabulary.example: Her kind words gave me encouragement when I felt nervous.

vocabulary.definition: Showing a readiness to give more of something than is strictly necessary.
vocabulary.example: Our neighbors were very generous and shared their fresh garden fruit.

vocabulary.definition: Having or showing behavior that is respectful and considerate.
vocabulary.example: It is always polite to say 'please' and 'thank you'.

vocabulary.definition: Giving or ready to give help; useful and supportive.
vocabulary.example: The local librarian gave us very helpful advice for our project.

vocabulary.definition: Give assistance, comfort, or encouragement to someone.
vocabulary.example: Good friends provide emotional support when life is stressful.

vocabulary.definition: A state of physical ease and freedom from pain, or soothing grief.
vocabulary.example: She comforted her friend with a warm hug and kind words.

vocabulary.definition: Become or make someone become less unhappy or more cheerful.
vocabulary.collocations: cheer up a friend, cheer up
vocabulary.example: We brought her flowers and chocolate to cheer her up.

vocabulary.definition: A pleased, kind, or amused facial expression.
vocabulary.example: His warm, bright smile made everyone feel welcome.

vocabulary.definition: Make the spontaneous sounds of lively amusement or joy.
vocabulary.example: We sat around the campfire laughing at funny childhood stories.

vocabulary.definition: Squeeze someone tightly in one's arms, typically to show affection.
vocabulary.example: She gave her mother a warm hug after arriving at the airport.

vocabulary.definition: Grasping someone's hand upon meeting or agreeing.
vocabulary.example: The two colleagues greeted each other with a firm handshake.

vocabulary.definition: A polite word or sign of welcome or recognition.
vocabulary.example: They exchanged warm holiday greetings on New Year's Eve.

vocabulary.definition: Words expressing praise for an achievement or good fortune.
vocabulary.example: Congratulations on passing your English speaking examination!

vocabulary.definition: An unexpected or astonishing event, fact, or thing.
vocabulary.example: Finding my childhood friend at the cafe was a pleasant surprise.

vocabulary.definition: The date on which an event took place in a previous year.
vocabulary.example: My parents celebrated their twenty-fifth wedding anniversary.

vocabulary.definition: A marriage ceremony, especially considered as including reception.
vocabulary.example: We were invited to attend a beautiful outdoor garden wedding.

vocabulary.definition: A formal religious or public occasion, typically celebration.
vocabulary.example: The university graduation ceremony was held in the grand auditorium.

vocabulary.definition: The activity of decorating; or festive ornaments and lights.
vocabulary.example: We put up colorful holiday decorations and lights around the house.

vocabulary.definition: A small colored rubber bag inflated with air or gas for parties.
vocabulary.example: The party room was decorated with yellow and blue balloons.

vocabulary.definition: A cylinder or block of wax with a central wick lit to give light.
vocabulary.example: She made a wish and blew out all the candles on her cake.

vocabulary.definition: An item of soft sweet food made from flour, sugar, and eggs.
vocabulary.example: Everyone enjoyed a generous slice of homemade chocolate cake.

vocabulary.definition: The act of raising a glass and drinking in honor of a person.
vocabulary.collocations: propose a toast, make a toast
vocabulary.example: The groom's father raised a glass to propose a toast to the couple.

vocabulary.definition: An assembly or meeting of people, especially family or friends.
vocabulary.example: The holiday family gathering brought together four generations.

vocabulary.definition: Recognize the full worth of someone or something; be grateful for.
vocabulary.example: I deeply appreciate all the help and patience you have shown me.

vocabulary.definition: The quality of being thankful; readiness to show appreciation.
vocabulary.example: She wrote a handwritten card to express her heartfelt gratitude.

vocabulary.definition: Express regret for something that one has done wrong.
vocabulary.collocations: apologize sincerely, apologize to a friend
vocabulary.example: He apologized sincerely for arriving late to the dinner party.

vocabulary.definition: Stop feeling angry or resentful toward someone for an offense.
vocabulary.example: True friends forgive each other quickly after a misunderstanding.

vocabulary.definition: Have a portion of something with another or others.
vocabulary.example: It is wonderful to sit together and share stories of our adventures.

vocabulary.definition: Be a member or part of a particular group or community.
vocabulary.collocations: sense of belonging, feel you belong
vocabulary.example: Being part of a supportive English class gives you a warm sense of belonging.

idioms.meaning: Supporting someone through good times and bad times.
idioms.example: True best friends stay by your side through thick and thin.

idioms.phrase: A friend in need is a friend indeed
idioms.meaning: A person who helps you when you have troubles is a true friend.
idioms.example: When I was sick, Maria cooked soup for me—a friend in need is a friend indeed.

idioms.meaning: To remember and talk about happy past events.
idioms.example: Looking through our old school yearbooks was a wonderful walk down memory lane.

idioms.meaning: To go out and celebrate joyfully with friends.
idioms.example: After passing all our exams, we went downtown to paint the town red!

roleplay.scenario: Congratulating a Friend and Planning a Weekend Celebration Dinner
roleplay.roleA: Call your friend to congratulate them on passing their English speaking test. Propose going out for a special celebration dinner this Friday.
roleplay.roleB: Thank your friend with gratitude, suggest your favorite local restaurant, and offer to invite two mutual friends to join the celebration.
roleplay.constraint: Both speakers must use at least 4 vocabulary words from today's list (e.g., congratulate, celebration, friend, gratitude, invite).
